import sys
import random

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 8)
q = rng.randint(1, 8)
a = sorted(rng.randint(-20, 20) for _ in range(n))
xs = [rng.randint(-25, 25) for _ in range(q)]
print(n, q)
print(" ".join(map(str, a)))
print(" ".join(map(str, xs)))
